posts.title: Philo Took a Kick to the Head From Kentucky's Gadson After His Go-Ahead TD — and No Flag Ever Came
posts.excerpt: Video still: Gator Bait Media. LEXINGTON, Ky. — Aaron Philo had just scored the touchdown that beat No. 11 Kentucky. Florida's quarterback was still on the ground in the end zone, teammates celebrating around him, when video of the play appears to show a Kentucky player making a kicking motion toward his head. No flag was thrown. Nobody in stripes appeared…
